allowed_networks.description: List of IP networks (CIDR notation) allowed to query this Chrony server.

use_local_clock.description: Enable a local hardware reference clock (e.g., PTP) as a stratum-0 fallback. Requires compatible hardware.

ntp_servers.description: Upstream NTP servers or pools to synchronize with. Each entry may include extra options (e.g., 'iburst', 'prefer').

log_metrics.description: Categories of logging to enable. Options include: all, measurements, statistics, tracking, rawdata, ratelimit, change.

min_sources.description: Minimum number of sources (from which at least one is acceptable) before Chrony will step the clock.

disable_hwtimestamp.description: Disable hardware timestamping support (for systems with unreliable or unsupported PTP/PHC).

stepback_threshold.description: If the clock is ahead of the reference by this threshold (seconds), it will be stepped backward on initial sync.
